nominee.longerDescription: Happy Woman Crush Wednesday! After featuring Sisi last week, I thought I might go for the other "Sisi" on my list, "Sissi in bp"! She's a Chinese student studying English Literature at ELTE, and she got some viral shorts exploring Hungary and trying to speak the language. It's interesting how she can speak Mandarin, Japanese, English, and a good bit of Hungarian, but with an English accent, so for a while I thought she comes from an English speaking country. I'm not losing my mind over someone just because they're Asian, but when I saw her Balaton video I was like HOLY SHIT
